title: 0.14.0: the Lore pane's links panel, forward history, and a Query tab (opum-doc#633)
description:
Operator instruction 2026-10-03 (opum-doc seq 181, ODOC-OP-2026-10-03-12, read verbatim on opum-agent OPAG-1094 at origin/dev 4bb5854c): start research on following document links, showing some form of graph, and querying it. Design of record: opum-doc docs/reference/lore-pane-links-and-graph-design.md (opum-ai/opum-doc#633, main 04e7646) -- read it there. (PATH CORRECTED 2026-10-14: this task named docs/reference/pane-links-and-graph-design.md, which does not exist; the file is lore-pane-links-and-graph-design.md.)

SLICED 2026-10-14 under DEC-193 (opum-ai/opum-doc#1005), which rules the surface: the neighbour list is NEITHER a `read` option NOR a new command -- `lore graph <id> --depth 1 --json` already returns inbound and outbound neighbours with edge kinds as {from, to, kind}, and `read` stays exactly as authored. The only CLI addition is `--limit <N>` on `lore graph`. This task is the umbrella; the work is in:
- LCLI-720 -- the CLI slice: add `--limit` to `lore graph`, proved both ways.
- LCLI-721 -- the mod slice: the pane's links panel, forward history and Query tab, consuming `graph --depth 1 --limit N`.

FIRST (unchanged): verify per surface that relative links press -- the API doc says links outside https, http and file draw as text -- and report the result.

NOT in 0.14.0: a drawn graph (dagre or graphology as Raster or Svg), a Graphviz Image, and a lore explorer handoff. Report issues with this design to opum-doc; make no design calls.
implementationNotes: DEC-193 (opum-ai/opum-doc#1005), filed by the leader 2026-10-14: the neighbour-list surface is neither a read option nor a new command -- graph --depth 1 already carries neighbours with edge kinds, and the only CLI addition is --limit on lore graph. Slice into LCLI-720 (CLI, --limit, proved both ways) and LCLI-721 (mod: links panel, forward history, Query tab). Doc path corrected to docs/reference/lore-pane-links-and-graph-design.md.
